title: EPIDERMOLYSIS BULLOSA SIMPLEX 7, WITH NEPHROPATHY AND DEAFNESS
alt_titles: NEPHROPATHY WITH PRETIBIAL EPIDERMOLYSIS BULLOSA AND DEAFNESS

relationships.phenotype: EPIDERMOLYSIS BULLOSA SIMPLEX 7, WITH NEPHROPATHY AND DEAFNESS

intro.text: A number sign (#) is used with this entry because of evidence that epidermolysis bullosa simplex with nephropathy and deafness (EBS7) is caused by homozygous mutation in the CD151 gene on chromosome 11p15.

checks.claim: Epidermolysis bullosa simplex with nephropathy and deafness (EBS7) is caused by homozygous mutation in the CD151 gene.
checks.evidence_quote: The 3 patients are homozygous for a single nucleotide insertion (G383) in exon 5 of CD151, causing a frameshift and premature stop signal at codon 140.
checks.explanation: Patients with nephritis, deafness and pretibial EB are homozygous for a CD151 mutation; the EBS7 label itself is OMIM nomenclature.

checks.claim: The CD151 gene is located on chromosome 11p15.
checks.evidence_quote: It is encoded by a gene at the same position on chromosome 11p15.5 as the MER2 blood group gene.
checks.explanation: 11p15.5 is within 11p15.

paragraphs.text: Epidermolysis bullosa simplex with nephropathy and deafness is an autosomal recessive disorder. Its main features are pretibial blistering of the skin, hereditary nephropathy that progresses to end-stage renal disease, and sensorineural deafness. Affected individuals lack the CD151 tetraspanin. Because CD151 carries the MER2 (RAPH) blood group antigen, they are MER2-negative.

checks.claim: Epidermolysis bullosa simplex with nephropathy and deafness is an autosomal recessive disorder.
checks.evidence_quote: The 3 patients are homozygous for a single nucleotide insertion (G383) in exon 5 of CD151
checks.explanation: The abstract never says the disorder is autosomal recessive. This is only implied by homozygosity in affected patients, two of whom are siblings.

checks.claim: Pretibial blistering of the skin is a main feature of epidermolysis bullosa simplex with nephropathy and deafness.
checks.evidence_quote: In addition to hereditary nephritis the sibs have sensorineural deafness, pretibial epidermolysis bullosa, and beta-thalassemia minor.
checks.explanation: Pretibial EB is a reported feature.

checks.claim: Hereditary nephropathy that progresses to end-stage renal disease is a main feature of epidermolysis bullosa simplex with nephropathy and deafness.
checks.evidence_quote: We examined CD151 in 3 MER2-negative patients (2 are sibs) of Indian Jewish origin with end-stage kidney disease. In addition to hereditary nephritis
checks.explanation: Hereditary nephritis with end-stage kidney disease is reported.

checks.claim: Sensorineural deafness is a main feature of epidermolysis bullosa simplex with nephropathy and deafness.
checks.evidence_quote: In addition to hereditary nephritis the sibs have sensorineural deafness, pretibial epidermolysis bullosa, and beta-thalassemia minor.
checks.explanation: Sensorineural deafness is reported.

checks.claim: Individuals affected by epidermolysis bullosa simplex with nephropathy and deafness lack the CD151 tetraspanin.
checks.evidence_quote: The resultant truncated protein would lack its integrin-binding domain.
checks.explanation: The abstract describes a predicted truncated protein. It does not state that patients lack CD151 entirely.

checks.claim: CD151 carries the MER2 (RAPH) blood group antigen.
checks.evidence_quote: We show that CD151 expresses the MER2 blood group antigen and is located on erythrocytes.
checks.explanation: RAPH is an alias that the paper does not mention, but the claim restates the paper's finding.

checks.claim: Individuals affected by epidermolysis bullosa simplex with nephropathy and deafness are MER2-negative.
checks.evidence_quote: We examined CD151 in 3 MER2-negative patients (2 are sibs) of Indian Jewish origin with end-stage kidney disease.
checks.explanation: The patients are MER2-negative.

paragraphs.text: Karamatic Crew et al. (2004) studied 3 MER2-negative individuals from 2 families. All 3 had end-stage hereditary nephritis, sensorineural deafness and pretibial epidermolysis bullosa. Skin and kidney findings pointed to defective assembly of basement membranes, including those of the glomerulus.

checks.claim: Karamatic Crew et al. (2004) studied 3 MER2-negative individuals from 2 families.
checks.evidence_quote: We examined CD151 in 3 MER2-negative patients (2 are sibs) of Indian Jewish origin with end-stage kidney disease.
checks.explanation: Three patients, two of them siblings, implies two families.

checks.claim: All 3 MER2-negative individuals studied by Karamatic Crew et al. (2004) had end-stage hereditary nephritis.
checks.evidence_quote: We examined CD151 in 3 MER2-negative patients (2 are sibs) of Indian Jewish origin with end-stage kidney disease.
checks.explanation: All 3 had end-stage kidney disease.

checks.claim: All 3 MER2-negative individuals studied by Karamatic Crew et al. (2004) had sensorineural deafness.
checks.evidence_quote: In addition to hereditary nephritis the sibs have sensorineural deafness, pretibial epidermolysis bullosa, and beta-thalassemia minor.
checks.explanation: The abstract attributes deafness only to the sibs, not to all 3 patients.

checks.claim: All 3 MER2-negative individuals studied by Karamatic Crew et al. (2004) had pretibial epidermolysis bullosa.
checks.evidence_quote: In addition to hereditary nephritis the sibs have sensorineural deafness, pretibial epidermolysis bullosa, and beta-thalassemia minor.
checks.explanation: The abstract attributes pretibial EB only to the sibs, not to all 3 patients.

checks.claim: Skin and kidney findings in the MER2-negative individuals studied by Karamatic Crew et al. (2004) pointed to defective assembly of basement membranes, including glomerular basement membranes.
checks.evidence_quote: We conclude that CD151 is essential for the proper assembly of the glomerular and tubular basement membrane in kidney, has functional significance in the skin
checks.explanation: This is the authors' conclusion. The abstract does not describe the specific skin or kidney findings, and for skin it says only 'functional significance', not defective basement membrane assembly.

paragraphs.text: The disorder is inherited in an autosomal recessive pattern. Karamatic Crew et al. (2004) found the causative CD151 mutation in the homozygous state in affected individuals.

checks.claim: Epidermolysis bullosa simplex with nephropathy and deafness is inherited in an autosomal recessive pattern.
checks.evidence_quote: The 3 patients are homozygous for a single nucleotide insertion (G383) in exon 5 of CD151
checks.explanation: Recessive inheritance is not stated. It is only implied by homozygosity.

checks.claim: Karamatic Crew et al. (2004) found the causative CD151 mutation in the homozygous state in individuals affected by epidermolysis bullosa simplex with nephropathy and deafness.
checks.evidence_quote: The 3 patients are homozygous for a single nucleotide insertion (G383) in exon 5 of CD151
checks.explanation: The mutation was found in the homozygous state.

paragraphs.text: Karamatic Crew et al. (2004) found a homozygous single-nucleotide insertion in the CD151 gene in MER2-negative patients with nephropathy, pretibial epidermolysis bullosa and deafness. The insertion caused a frameshift and a truncated protein that lacked the MER2 antigen. The authors concluded that CD151 is needed for the correct assembly of basement membranes in kidney, skin and the inner ear.

checks.claim: Karamatic Crew et al. (2004) found a homozygous single-nucleotide insertion in the CD151 gene in MER2-negative patients with nephropathy, pretibial epidermolysis bullosa and deafness.
checks.evidence_quote: The 3 patients are homozygous for a single nucleotide insertion (G383) in exon 5 of CD151, causing a frameshift and premature stop signal at codon 140.
checks.explanation: The patients are MER2-negative and have nephritis, deafness and EB.

checks.claim: The single-nucleotide insertion in CD151 found by Karamatic Crew et al. (2004) caused a frameshift.
checks.evidence_quote: causing a frameshift and premature stop signal at codon 140
checks.explanation: The insertion causes a frameshift.

checks.claim: The single-nucleotide insertion in CD151 found by Karamatic Crew et al. (2004) resulted in a truncated CD151 protein that lacked the MER2 antigen.
checks.evidence_quote: The resultant truncated protein would lack its integrin-binding domain.
checks.explanation: The abstract says the truncated protein would lack the integrin-binding domain. It does not say the protein lacks the MER2 antigen; that is only implied by the patients being MER2-negative.

checks.claim: Karamatic Crew et al. (2004) concluded that CD151 is needed for the correct assembly of basement membranes in kidney, skin and the inner ear.
checks.evidence_quote: CD151 is essential for the proper assembly of the glomerular and tubular basement membrane in kidney, has functional significance in the skin, is probably a component of the inner ear
checks.explanation: Essential basement membrane assembly is concluded only for kidney. For skin the paper says 'functional significance' and for the inner ear 'probably a component'.

paragraphs.text: Vahidnezhad et al. (2018) reported biallelic CD151 mutations in a patient with epidermolysis bullosa simplex. This finding widened the range of skin phenotypes linked to CD151 deficiency.

checks.claim: Vahidnezhad et al. (2018) reported biallelic CD151 mutations in a patient with epidermolysis bullosa simplex.
checks.explanation: not supported by any of the 3 cited papers. This is about Vahidnezhad et al. (2018), which this abstract does not address.

checks.claim: The finding of biallelic CD151 mutations in a patient with epidermolysis bullosa simplex by Vahidnezhad et al. (2018) widened the range of skin phenotypes linked to CD151 deficiency.
checks.explanation: not supported by any of the 3 cited papers. This is about a later paper that this abstract does not address.
